question: Does the identity-proved current-main trace contain a policy-sensitive, viable and Scoreline-separated capacity substrate for one Dusk-only same-turn alternating Attack/Skill three-card cadence, without exact named-card acquisition or a generic added-card main effect?
hypothesis: A three-card alternating Attack/Skill cadence removes the measured exact-consumer reservation and added-card confounding bottlenecks while retaining enough active, inactive, viable and functionally separate policies to justify one research-only identity prototype.

closedFamilyExclusions.namedCardSequencing: Do not reopen the exact Scoreline or Afterimage skeletons, their ordering controls or their commitment fallbacks.
closedFamilyExclusions.addedExistingCard: Do not add an existing card: the Scoreline component panel measured a generic Executioner main effect and closed that representation.
closedFamilyExclusions.nativeScalarAndStructuralFamilies: Do not reconstruct the closed Kindle, Ward, Shatter, Cracked tempo, Ember-reserve, relic, one-bit setup, action-economy, weak-mend, private-debt or historical scalar paths.
closedFamilyExclusions.method: No ML, RL, optimiser, policy remap or adaptive candidate tuning is permitted.

mechanismContract.scope: Duskblade only; Ashwarden and the off setting are exact current-main null paths.
mechanismContract.carrier: The existing Dusk start relic Emberheart is the proposed research gate; its authored six-HP post-combat heal remains unchanged.
mechanismContract.producer: The first played card of type Attack or Skill in the current player turn begins an alternating streak.
mechanismContract.mediator: One turn-local integer streak length over consecutive eligible card plays; a same-type eligible play resets it to one and a played Power or other non-Attack/non-Skill card clears it.
mechanismContract.consumer: The third consecutive eligible card whose type differs from the immediately previous eligible card in the same player turn.
mechanismContract.payoff: After the consumer's unchanged authored effects, gain exactly one Ember through the existing bounded Ember operation, at most once in that player turn.
mechanismContract.lifecycle: The streak and paid flag reset at each player-turn start and disappear at combat end; they never enter RunState or a save.
mechanismContract.naturalCost: Draw, pay for and deliberately sequence three alternating Attack/Skill cards in one turn.
mechanismContract.acquisition: None. The proposed carrier is the existing Dusk start relic and no card, relic, pool, reward, ChoiceScreen or deterministic assignment is added.
mechanismContract.stateEncoding: If capacity passes, the identity prototype may add only one bounded turn-local cadence counter and one once-per-turn paid flag to CombatState.
mechanismContract.rng: No RNG call, cursor movement or new random identity.
mechanismContract.telemetry: Direct research-only producer, mediator-advance/reset, consumer, payoff and turn-expiry stages with card ID, card type, streak and realised Ember delta.

duskCadencePayoff.status: Only an opportunity proxy is evaluated here. The non-null level may be implemented only after capacity success.

scorelinePayoff.status: Fixed absent; used only as a cached overlap anchor.

afterimagePayoff.status: Fixed absent; used only as a cached overlap anchor.

current-main-trace.meaning: Identity-proved explicit-null current-main observations. Deterministic code reconstructs the non-interventional upper-bound opportunity only.

design.type: zero-new-row complete-cohort capacity and alias audit; not a factorial and not a causal experiment
design.construction: Evaluate the one frozen three-card grammar across every player turn in all 256 rows before applying exact support, breadth, viability, reliability and anchor-separation rules.
design.cardTypeRule: Card type is read from the frozen current-main content. Attack and Skill are eligible. A Power or any other played type breaks the streak. Lantern Art, potions, draw events and unplayed cards are outside it.
design.cardOrderRule: Within a player turn, card-play event identity determines order. At most the first qualifying alternating triple per turn is counted, matching the proposed once-per-turn payoff.
design.mechanisticallyJustifiedInteraction: The proposed payoff requires the interaction of card-type alternation and a third eligible play; neither an isolated card type nor generic card acquisition is a candidate factor.
design.aliasStructure: Attack-Skill-Attack and Skill-Attack-Skill are symmetric orientations of one cadence factor, not separate candidates. Exact named card triples are breadth witnesses, never separately selected cells.
design.interference: No Scoreline or Afterimage setting varies. Their frozen current-main opportunity sets are shared anchors used only to reject a repertoire alias before implementation.
design.omittedCells: No payoff level sweep, named-card subset, acquisition factor, policy control, Ash cell, RandomBuild cell, simulator row, held-out row, joint package cell, ML, RL, optimiser or protected-seed cell is authorised.

trace.selectionRule: Read the complete sole 256-row co-hand-telemetry explicit-null arm. No row, policy, seed, turn, card or endpoint is selected after observation.

cohort.identity: Every policy and seed from the complete identity-proved current-main rectangle is used exactly once; there is one frozen policy snapshot per identity across its four seeds.

scoreline.definition: A robust policy plays Chisel before a later Executioner in one fight in at least two of four frozen rows.
scoreline.status: Immutable overlap anchor only; no Scoreline payoff or causal claim is estimated.

afterimage.definition: A robust policy simultaneously holds Ward and Warden's Edge in at least two of four frozen rows.
afterimage.status: Immutable conservative overlap anchor only; the Afterimage family remains closed.

estimands.unit: Policy identity over its complete four-seed rectangle.
estimands.active: At least one same-turn alternating eligible three-card opportunity in at least two of four rows.
estimands.inactive: No qualifying opportunity in any of four rows.
estimands.viable: An active policy with at least one qualifying row that wins.
estimands.breadth: Distinct exact card identities in all three positions, distinct exact card triples and observed rows in both symmetric type orientations.
estimands.separation: Candidate-only, anchor-only, cross-active and Jaccard policy-set overlap against the separate Scoreline and Afterimage anchors.
estimands.reliability: Pre-existing stall/error rows in the immutable trace; no added-fault estimand exists because no simulator or intervention runs.
estimands.notEstimated: Mediator identity, Ember payoff, causal complementarity, duration effect, RandomBuild/global-power movement, Ash isolation, held-out reproducibility, package admission, detector score, product balance or protected confirmation.

gates.provenance: The 16-policy support and inactivity minima, eight-policy viability and separate-anchor minima, 0.55 overlap ceiling and one immutable baseline-fault ceiling reuse the frozen 64-policy structural-capacity scale. Four cards per position and eight exact triples are the minimum breadth that rejects an exact named-card alias while staying below the policy-support floor.

decisionRules.success: Every immutable, trace, policy-identity, support, viability, breadth, orientation, anchor-separation, reliability, budget and zero-ledger check passes at the sole complete look.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply boundary 1: freeze only the exact alternating-three-ember-one contract for one separately preregistered exact-null and direct-mediator identity prototype. Do not vary length, orientation, payoff, carrier, card type, acquisition or policy and do not add a simulator row before that identity protocol is frozen.
decisionRules.futility: Any declared capacity, viability, breadth, orientation, anchor-separation or reliability gate fails on the complete immutable trace.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply boundary 2: close the exact Dusk cadence family without subset, length, orientation, payoff, carrier, cohort, policy or method rescue and continue with the next evidence-backed minimal structural mechanism inside #421.
decisionRules.inconclusive: An immutable input, trace, schema, policy-identity, ledger or wall-time check prevents the complete deterministic decision.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply boundary 3: record the exact missing gate at the frozen cap; do not repair, rerun, extend, replace the trace or use protected seeds.

order: Verify live task, repository/archive refs, source, task capsule, helper, trace and ledger identities.
Reconstruct all player turns and the one frozen cadence opportunity deterministically from the complete trace.
Apply the exact support, viability, breadth, orientation, separation and reliability gates once.
Verify the ledger is byte-identical and apply exactly one decision boundary.
executionAndStopping.stopping: One zero-row complete-cohort look. No sequential peeking, option enumeration, subset selection, threshold relaxation, cohort replacement or endpoint addition.
